The role

The Global Out-of-Home (OOH) Excellence team is responsible for developing world-class capabilities that enable sustainable growth, operational excellence, and superior customer experiences across all markets. By defining strategic standards, future-fit operating models, technology roadmaps, and governance frameworks, the team drives consistency, scalability, and innovation across the global OOH network. 

The GTM Transformation Manager (d/w/m) is responsible for defining the strategic direction and transformation roadmap for Go-to-Market capabilities across the global Ice Cream business. This role owns the vision, governance, capability development agenda, and continuous improvement strategy for critical GTM processes including distributor management, retail execution, route optimization, order management, delivery planning, warehouse operations, and supporting technologies. 

A key aspect of this role is working directly with markets to understand operational realities and identify improvement opportunities through operational assessments, audits, and capability reviews. 

What you'll be responsible for

Define the long-term GTM capability vision, roadmap, and transformation priorities. 

Own governance and global standards for distributor management, retail execution, route optimization, order collection, delivery planning, and warehouse management. 

Lead large-scale GTM transformation programs across markets. 

Provide strategic oversight of GTM technologies including DMS, retail execution, warehouse and analytics platforms. 

Lead end-to-end market assessments and operational excellence reviews. 

Observe day-to-day operations in markets to identify capability gaps and improvement opportunities. 

Facilitate operational audits, workshops and diagnostic sessions with market teams, consultants etc.

Develop actionable improvement roadmaps and monitor delivery of agreed actions. 

Influence senior stakeholders and align strategic investments and priorities. 

Manage strategic relationships with vendors and external partners. 

We're looking for someone who

Brings significant experience in FMCG, sales operations, customer operations, supply chain, GTM excellence or related fields.

Has a strong track record of leading transformation programs and driving capability development at scale.

Demonstrates deep expertise in route-to-market strategies, distributor management, retail execution and operational excellence.

Has experience conducting operational reviews, diagnostics, audits and capability assessments.

Combines strategic thinking with strong analytical and commercial acumen.

Is comfortable working with technology-enabled solutions and has strong digital and systems understanding.

Influences and collaborates effectively with senior stakeholders across functions, markets and cultures.

Thrives in complex, global environments and can balance strategic priorities with hands-on execution.

Is willing to travel internationally on a regular basis (approximately 30%+ of working time) to support market reviews, workshops and transformation initiatives.

Typically brings 8–12 years of relevant professional experience.

Business-fluent English skills are required; proficiency in additional foreign languages is considered an advantage.

Flexible ways of working

Support for health, wellbeing and life outside of work

Last but not least – all the ice cream you can eat!

You’ll thrive here if you value an inclusive culture, with low ego and hierarchy - and if you’re excited to continuously learn and challenge how we work, using digital, data, and new thinking to push us forward.

jobs.occupation: Senior Microelectronics Engineer(m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.description:
About us NET CHECK GmbH was founded in 1999 with the aim of improving the quality of communication networks. Since then, NET CHECK has developed into the leading partner of network operators and infrastructure providers of mobile and fixed networks of all technologies. Its core competencies include international network benchmarking (comparative measurements) as well as network planning and fault analysis. NET CHECK has one of Germany's largest crowdsourcing platforms, which generates over 144 million data points every day. Our commitment to quality and security has earned us the trust of scientific and government institutions.
NET CHECK is headquartered in Berlin and is part of the NC GROUP, an owner-managed group of companies with a total of over 180 employees at five locations in Germany and one in Belgrade, Serbia.

Job Summary: We are seeking a Senior Microelectronics Engineer for Embedded Systems to join our hardware R&D team. The successful candidate will play a key role in the design, development and validation of electronics and embedded solutions for telecommunication measurement systems. This position involves leading the design of microelectronic circuits, developing embedded firmware and ensuring the integration across hardware and software components.
Responsibilities
• Design and develop microelectronic circuits for telecom measurement equipment.
• Develop and optimize embedded firmware for STM32 microcontrollers using C/C++, with expertise in UART, Ethernet, and USB communication interfaces.
• Perform schematic design, prototyping and laboratory testing to ensure product reliability and compliance with telecom industry standards.
• Lead design reviews and drive design improvements across hardware and firmware domains.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams (hardware, software and mechanical) to integrate hardware designs into system architecture.
• Research and evaluate latest microelectronics and embedded technologies relevant to telecom measurement systems.
• Prepare comprehensive technical documentation, including design specifications, verification procedures and detailed engineering reports.
• Provide technical guidance to junior engineers while contributing to continuous improvement initiative within the hardware R&D team.

Your profile
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, or a related field.
• 5+ years of experience in microelectronics and embedded system design.
• Proven expertise in embedded firmware development using C/C++ on STM32 or similar ARM-based microcontrollers.
• Hands-on experience with communication interfaces such as UART, Ethernet and USB.
• Solid knowledge in circuit design, PCB layout design and hardware debugging.
• Proficiency with electronic design in CAD tools (e.g. KiCAD, Eagle).
• Familiarity with RF systems, telecom interfaces (e.g., LTE, 5G, Wi-Fi), and signal processing is a strong plus.
• Experience in laboratory testing, prototyping and performance optimization of embedded systems.
• Excellent communication skills in English (written and spoken), German is a plus.

We Offer
• Employment Type: Full-Time, indefinite term.
• A dynamic team characterized by creativity, collaboration, and technical excellence, creating an innovative workplace.
• Flexible working hours.
• 28 vacation days.
• Health & Sports Subsidy: Sports membership subsidy.
• Public Transportation Subsidy: Monthly subsidy for a Germany-wide ticket.
• Bicycle leasing via JobRad.
• Regular Team Events.

jobs.occupation: Marine Operations & QCM Specialist – Vessel Operations, Quality Control & Claims (m/f/d) (Schifffahrtskaufmann/-frau - Linienfahrt)
jobs.description:
About us

We are the European general agency of the globally active shipping company KAWASAKI KISEN KAISHA Ltd. ("K" Line). As a leading shipping company in the RoRo business, we offer highly sophisti­cated and tailor-made mari­time trans­port solu­tions to our custo­mers from the automotive and heavy machinery indus­tries. As European headquarters based in Hamburg, we are respon­sible for plan­ning and managing the regular services from Europe to North America and Asia as well as their marke­ting in Europe.

Your responsibilities

- Support technical assessment and acceptance of cargoes incl. High & Heavy, special and project cargo as well as review of operational handling
- Support IMDG-related coordination, including documentation review, DG stowage information and operational communication with vessels and ports.
- Participate in cargo quality follow-up, damage prevention, port attendance, vessel feedback and survey-related matters.
- Support QCM/VOS team with analysis of operational deviations, near misses, cargo damage cases and root-cause identification incl. standardization of workflows, SOPs, checklists and digital tools.
- Assist with claims handling by reviewing damage documentation, survey reports, incident reports and operational evidence.
- Prepare and issue voyage instructions, discharging instructions, sailing information and operational updates in internal systems.
- Communicate with vessels, ship management companies, local offices, ports, agents and internal departments to maintain scheduled voyages.
- Support bunkering coordination, including confirmation of fuel specifications and review of bunker supplier information.
- Prepare, review and distribute cargo stowage plans to relevant parties.
- Collect and follow up operational cost reports from local offices.
- Assist with environmental and technical matters related to vessel operations.
- Support operational follow-up in case of disruption, delay, off-hire or other vessel-related incidents.
- Prepare summaries, meeting materials, reports incl. incident reports in case of accidents, serious cargo damage or operational irregularities and coordinate required follow-up actions.

Your profile

- Completed vocational training, university degree or comparable qualification related to shipping, logistics, nautical science, marine operations or port operations.
- Nautical background, sea-going experience, port captain experience or marine technical experience is an advantage.
- Professional experience in RoRo shipping, vessel operations, port logistics, cargo planning, High & Heavy, survey or claims handling is desirable.
- Good understanding of vessel operations, port processes, cargo flow, stowage planning and international communication chains.
- Knowledge of the IMO CSS Code, IMDG Code and SOLAS is an advantage.
- Very good written and spoken English; German language skills are expressly preferred.
- Careful working style, strong affinity for numbers, good prioritization skills and a sense of responsibility in critical situations.
- Willingness to travel to European ports, terminals, vessels and service providers as well as a Class B driving license.

Digital competencies

- Confident use of Microsoft 365, especially Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams and SharePoint.
- Experience working with structured data, operational reports, Excel analyses and management documents.
- Openness towards digital collaboration tools such as SharePoint Lists, Planner, Loop or comparable solutions.
- Basic understanding and responsible use of modern AI models and AI-supported applications in the daily work context.

We offer:

- Permanent full-time position in an international maritime environment
- Cross-departmental role between Vessel Operations and Quality Control & Marine Technical with a diverse range of responsibilities
- Close collaboration with international colleagues, ports, vessels, OEMs, surveyors, and ship management teams worldwide
- Great intercultural corporate culture with the opportunity to work across global networks
- Attractive remuneration package, including additional benefits such as vacation pay and a 13th monthly salary
- Additional allowances for the Deutschlandticket, fitness center, Ticket Plus® City, and more
- Capital-forming benefits (Vermögenswirksame Leistungen)
- Flexible working hours and attractive mobile working options to support a positive work-life balance
- Modern office conveniently located near a central HVV hub in Hamburg

Contact:

If you would like to join our team, please send your application in English (application letter, curriculum vitae, references), stating your salary expectations and the earliest possible date of entry, to jobs@de.kline.com (https://mailto:jobs@de.kline.com?subject=Application%20as%20Team%20Member%20(m%2Ff%2Fd)%20Vessel%20Operations) .

Anckelmannsplatz 1, 20537 Hamburg

* Provide technical support for a business-critical corporate application

* Solid understanding of Microsoft Windows Server operating systems and familiarity with AWS services and infrastructure
* Basic knowledge of MS SQL Server, Microsoft ActiveDirectory Services and IIS
* Understanding of XML EDI Interface
* Strong communication and problem-solving skills; experience in a multicultural or multilingual environment is a plus
* Professional proficiency in English; ideally also German or additional languages

* Hellmann Spirit: Culture focussing on people & relationship. Regular team and company events. Birthday lottery ticket from the German TV lottery.

jobs.occupation: Life Scientist (m/w/d) (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.description:
The Leibniz Institute of Virology (LIV) is an independent research institution for basic biomedical research. As a foundation under civil law and member of the Leibniz Association, the institute occupies a leading position both nationally and internationally.

The Research Department Viral Zoonoses - One Health, headed by Prof. Dr. Gülşah Gabriel, investigates the interspecies transmission of influenza A viruses from animals to humans and the molecular mechanisms of pathogenesis in humans, particularly with regard to risk factors (pregnancy, obesity, and gender dependence). The department aims to identify and characterize viral and cellular determinants driving increased pathogenicity and transmissibility. These insights are further extended to other respiratory viruses, including SARS-CoV-2 and RSV, with particular attention to post-acute sequelae and their long-term impact. Ultimately, the knowledge gained will inform the development of novel antiviral strategies.

We are looking for a highly motivated, ambitious, and team-oriented candidate for a

Postdoc Position (f/m/x)
Conduct and shape a research project on the pathogenesis of respiratory virus infections under BSL-2 and BSL-3 conditions
Work as an independent researcher with accountability towards the research project
Preparation and submission of animal experimentation applications in compliance with regulatory requirements, including direct liaison with the relevant authorities to ensure timely approval
Integrate into the research team and provide support for junior members / students
Present research findings at national and international level
Develop future research projects and draft manuscripts

Solid expertise in virology or cell biology and experimental laboratory work
Experience in conducting animal experiments
Strong commitment, team spirit, very good communication and organizational skills, and ability to work in an independent and flexible manner
PhD degree in life sciences
Very good German and English language skills (oral and written)

Working as part of a highly motivated team in a state-of-the-art, international research environment with excellent core facilities
Remuneration according to EG 13 TV-AVH (Hamburg Employment Law Association Collective Agreement) (comparable to TVöD - Civil Service Collective Agreement), including company pension scheme
30 days of annual vacation
Opportunity to obtain FELASA C certification, providing the qualification to independently conduct animal experimentation
Further training opportunities, including subsidized English and German courses at the institute
Grant for unscheduled child care
Health protection offers at the institute (in cooperation with voiio GmbH)
Flexible, family-friendly working hours
HVV Deutschlandticket subsidy
Canteen use subsidy

The position is initially limited for two years with starting date January 1, 2027.

The LIV is certified with the TOTAL E-QUALITY distinction and promotes work-life balance and professional equality between employees of all genders. Severely disabled persons will be given preferential consideration if their suitability, qualifications, and professional performance are otherwise equal.

Company Description

Continental is a leading tire manufacturer and industry specialist. Founded in 1871, the company generated sales of €19.7 billion in 2025 and currently employs around 76,000 people in 54 countries and markets.

Tire solutions from the Tires group sector make mobility safer and smarter. Its premium portfolio encompasses car, truck, bus, two-wheel, and specialty tires as well as smart solutions and services for fleets and tire retailers. Continental has been delivering top performance for more than 150 years and is one of the world’s largest tire manufacturers. In fiscal 2025, the Tires group sector generated sales of 13.8 billion euros. Continental's tire division currently employs around 53,000 people worldwide and has 19 production and 16 development sites.

Job Description

Kick-start your HR career with us! In our HR team in Hanover-Stöcken, you'll gain practical insights into talent development, employer branding, digitalization, and many other exciting HR topics.

Start as soon as possible in a 6-month internship. A combination of mandatory and voluntary internship periods is possible, and partial remote work can be arranged.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

- Work with an international network of HR and business stakeholders
- Drive your own tasks in global HR and talent development projects
- Help shape learning and development initiatives for employees worldwide
- Create impactful presentations and insightful analyses
- Support workshops, trainings, and global HR activities

Qualifications

- Students (m/f/diverse) in the field of Business Administration or comparable degree programs with a focus on Human Resource Management
- Initial experience or a strong interest in Human Resources
- Proficient in using the MS Office package (Outlook, PowerPoint, Excel)
- Very good command of English, both written and spoken
- German language skills are a plus
- High level of commitment, creativity, and enjoyment of teamwork
- Structured way of working as well as strong initiative
- Enjoyment of communication in an international environment

Please attach your current certificate of enrollment and also your current transcripts of records and an extract of certificate for a mandatory internship. Those documents are mandatory for processing your application.

If required, please submit your valid residence permit as well as your work permit including the additional sheet.

Applications from severely handicapped people are welcome.

jobs.occupation: Corporate Counsel Legal Expert  / all genders / Part-fulltime (Jurist/in)
jobs.description:
Work Your Magic with us!

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.

Your role:

As Corporate Counsel, you will advise internal clients on digital transformation initiatives, emerging technologies, and technology-related legal regulations, including the AI Act, Data Act, Cyber Resilience Act, and other digital regulations. You will support the development and implementation of governance frameworks, policies, and processes relating to artificial intelligence, data, software, IT security, and digital innovation across the organization. Furthermore, you will advise on a broad range of legal issues relating to AI, data, intellectual property, open-source software, digital business models and emerging technologies.

You will draft, review, and negotiate complex technology and commercial agreements, including software licensing, SaaS, cloud services, digital solutions, IT projects and outsourcing arrangements. jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Researcher (f/m/d) to characterize young star-planet systems and their flaring activity (Astrophysiker/in, Astronom/in)
jobs.description:
The Max Planck Institute for Solar System Research (MPS) in Göttingen is one of the world's leading research institutions in the field of solar physics and planetary research with around 300 employees. The interdisciplinary research focus is the investigation of the development, diversity and dynamics of planets, moons, small bodies, the sun and solar-like stars. The MPS develops and operates scientific instruments for current and future space missions (e.g. ESA, NASA), and carries out cosmochemical laboratory investigations of meteorites as well as numerical modeling on state-of-the-art supercomputers.

The Department Solar & Stellar Interiors at MPS invites applications for the position of a

Postdoctoral Researcher (f/m/d) to characterize young star-planet systems and their flaring activity

In recent years, exoplanetary science has undergone a major shift -- moving from exoplanet detection towards understanding star-planet systems as a whole, including the host star, interplanetary medium and galactic context. Specifically, tidal and magnetic interactions between planets and their host stars have been recognized to be able to modulate the evolution of both, including the atmospheric evolution of the planet and its habitability. The newly established ERC StG project PLANETARE seeks a postdoctoral researcher with a background in stellar magnetism and/or exoplanetary science to develop novel ways of detecting and characterizing the mutual influence of stars and planets with a focus on the influence of planets in short orbits on the magnetism of their host stars. At the core of the project is a new way to find exoplanets: detecting them through their magnetic interaction with the host star. This position builds the observational foundation - the sample, the activity catalog, and the geometry of the systems - and confirms any transiting planets among the interacting systems.

Your Tasks

- Compile the most accurate and complete flaring activity catalog to date using space-borne photometry
- Search the sample of flaring stars for transiting planet candidates using space-borne photometry
- Constrain the orientation of the rotational and magnetic axes of interacting systems
- Measure stellar activity characteristics and their predictive power for interaction

The transit search, flaring catalog and geometry measurements will constrain some of the drivers of interaction and its observability, working towards a true occurrence rate of magnetic interaction in young star-planet systems. You will work closely with a second postdoc (https://karriere.mps.mpg.de/jobposting/ff58b9b82b6efc0b224bf8134f1471929fdc639c0) within a small, newly formed team of two postdocs and a PhD student, led by the PI (Ekaterina Ilin). Group members are supported to lead their own papers and proposals, and to present at international meetings in both the stellar and exoplanet communities.

Your Qualification

- A PhD in physics or astrophysics (PhD must be awarded by the start date)
- Previous experience in observational astronomy, ideally including space-borne optical photometry
- The ability to work in a team
- A good command of the English language

Our Offer

- Comprehensive onboarding, professional development and further training opportunities
- Diverse and varied tasks in an international work environment
- Renumeration according to TVöDBund, based on qualifications and experience, annual bonus and additional pension scheme (VBL)
- 30 days of vacation plus 4 additional days off
- Full-time and part-time employment; flexible working time and possibility of mobile work
- Cooperation with local bilingual Montessori child care center
- Good connection by public transport
- Corporate health management

Additional Information

- Start date between January and October 2027
- Duration: 4 years
- Remuneration is according to EG 13 TVöD-Bund
- Application deadline is October 30, 2026 (interviews in late November / early December 2026)

We look forward to receiving your informative application documents (cover letter, CV, references, certificates). Please submit these via the digital application portal (https://www.mps.mpg.de/career/jobs (https://www.mps.mpg.de/career/jobs) ). If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact Dr. Ekaterina Ilin (ilin@mps.mpg.de (ilin@mps.mpg.de) ).

The Max Planck Society endeavours to achieve gender equality and diversity. Furthermore, the Max Planck Society seeks to increase the number of women in those areas where they are underrepresented and therefore explicitly encourages women to apply. The Max Planck Society is committed to increasing the number of individuals with disabilities in its workforce and therefore encourages applications from such qualified individuals

jobs.description:
Universität Hildesheim
Stiftung des öffentlichen Rechts

Job advertisement
Reference number 2026/121

The following position is to be filled at the Institute of Computer Science,
Information Systems and Machine Learning Lab (ISMLL) has a vacancy for a

PhD Position in Machine Learning (m/f/d)
(TV-L E 13, 100%)

the position is full-time, can be filled immediately, and is initially
offered for three years. The salary is according to TV-L E13 (roughly 57,000
EUR gross income per year).

As a PhD student in our international ML research group you conduct research
in ML guided by a postdoc and two professors, have the opportunity to cooperate
with companies, small and large, as well as with academic partners on real-word
ML problems, and are encouraged to assist in teaching ML courses in our
renowned International Master‘s Program in Data Analytics to students from all
over the world. The working language of our group is English. You will work in
a beautiful town with UNESCO World Heritage Sites, located in the very center
of Germany, just 30 km from Hanover and 1.5 hours. by high-speed train to Berlin

Who we are:

The Information Systemsand Machine Learning Lab (ISMLL) at the Institute of
Computer Science of the University of Hildesheim is an international research
group an machine learning, especially predictive modelling and probabilistic
methods for complex data and complex decisions, with an excellent publication
track record (NeurlPS, ICML, ICLR, AAAI, ACM KDD, ECML PKDD, etc.). Current
research directions include time series forecasting, probabilistic machine
learning, graph neural networks, recommender systems, and mathematical
foundations of machine learning. ISMLL takes part in basic and applied research
projects in various domains such as mobility, e-commerce, and
technologyenhanced learning. Seehttp://www.ismll.uni-hildesheim.defor more
information. The Institute of Computer Science, of which ISMLL is part, has a
streng focus on artificial intelligence, with three chairs working in this
field. The University of Hildesheim is renowned for high-quality research and
education.

What we expect:

We are looking for a gifted student who loves models, algorithms, and data,
can hardly stop discussing them with others, likes to express their ideas in
formulas and programs, and now wants to get to the bottom of a complex ML
problem over the next three years. You should have a recent Master's degree in
Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, or a closely related
area. A Master's thesis on an ML topic and ML-related courses in your Master's
program will be an asset. You are expected to have strong analytic and
programming skills, the ability to work independently, and strong interpersonal
as weil as English language skills.

As a family-friendly university, we offer a varied, interdisciplinary range
of tasks, flexible working hours, regular further and advanced training and a
special annual payment within the framework of TV-L. In joining the university,
you will become part of a dynamic, committed and open-minded team.

The University of Hildesheim has adopted a mission statement that places
great importance on gender equality and diversity.

The University of Hildesheim particularly wants to promote the professional
equality of women and men. Therefore, it aims to increase the proportion of
employees of the gender that is underrepresented in the respective area.

In the case of equal qualification and suitability, applications from
applicants with severe disabilities will be given preferential consideration.

For university degrees obtained abroad, a certificate evaluation by the
Central Office for Foreign Education (ZAB) is required as proof of equivalence
before you are hired. Please apply for this in good time if necessary. You can
find more information athttps://zab.kmk.org/de/zeugnisbewertung.

Until when and how to apply
Please apply online using reference number 2026/121 at
https://www.ismll.uni-hildesheim.de/apply/, uploading your CV with your
transcripts and a research statement. Please enclose a PDF of a technical text
of yours, such as a first paper, your Master's thesis, or a seminar paper you
wrote. You can submit your application online at any time; once we have found
our new .PhD student, the application portal will be closed. We will store and
process your personal data during the application process and delete it
afterwards. For any further questions, please contact Prof. Dr. Dr. Lars
Schmidt-Thieme (schmidt-thieme@ismll.uni-hildesheim.de) or Prof. Dr. Tom Hanika
(tom.hanika@uni-hildesheim.de) via email.

jobs.occupation: International Marketing Manager - NUK, Baby Jogger (Produktmanager/in)
jobs.description:
International Marketing Manager – NUK, Baby Jogger

Location: Zeven or Hamburg, DE, or London (Hammersmith), UK

Contract type: Permanent

Your Role & Team in a Nutshell

As an International Marketing Manager, you will play a key role in growing our brands NUK, Tigex, Baby Jogger, Aprica, Graco and Billy Boy across EMEA and APAC. You will turn global strategies into clear regional plans that connect with consumers, strengthen our presence in the market and drive growth. Working closely with local marketing teams, you will help shape how our brands show up in each market, ensuring plans are clear, relevant and delivered effectively.

This is an independent, hands-on role where you will take ownership of delivering innovation and brand plans across the regions. You will work closely with global and local teams, acting as the main point of contact to make sure plans are clear and delivered effectively. Success in this role comes from understanding consumers, making confident decisions and taking a proactive, self-driven approach to getting things done.

We will help you achieve your goals and develop by providing regular feedback and access to training courses.

Your Key Responsibilities

Strategy

- Lead the regional translation and execution of brand and portfolio strategies, setting clear priorities, choices and trade-offs, delivered on time and in full.
- Define distribution strategies, including merchandising and channel assortment, and translate strategic priorities into clear execution roadmaps, proactively challenging risks and misalignment.

Insights and Data

- Build strong knowledge of categories, target consumers and competitors to guide decision-making using internal and external insights.
- Analyse market and execution performance, using data to set priorities, improve effectiveness and drive timely corrective actions.

Product Development (Innovation and Portfolio Execution)

- Own the regional deployment of innovation and influence pipeline priorities to support effective execution and growth.
- Lead portfolio lifecycle management, ensuring markets are launch-ready and equipped with the right materials, timing and execution standards.

Brand Communication (In-market Excellence)

- Ensure consistent, high-quality brand communication across all Baby brands in the region.
- Support local teams in adapting communications to market needs while protecting brand equity, and act as a quality gate for messaging and execution.

Pricing

- Use shopper insights and market data to shape pricing strategies, guardrails and product configurations to maximise value.
- Lead pricing audits and support accurate in-market execution, identifying risks and key promotional opportunities with local teams.

Market Enablement

- Act as the primary regional contact for local marketing teams, ensuring alignment and accountability for delivering regional strategy and innovation priorities.
- Establish effective ways of working, supporting prioritisation, capability development and continuous improvement in execution quality.

What You'll Need

Minimum:

- Degree in Marketing, Business or a related field, with experience in international or multi-market marketing roles in consumer goods or lifestyle brands.
- Strong commercial understanding, including building business cases and working with P&L, alongside experience in pricing and product range management.
- Experience in product development and launches, including adapting global campaigns for local markets while maintaining brand consistency.
- Proven track record of delivering results and driving growth in a fast-paced environment, with a good understanding of compliance requirements.
- Fluent in English and German, both written and spoken

Your Advantage:

- Strong analytical skills, using data and insights to understand performance and identify growth opportunities.
- Able to work across multiple markets, influencing stakeholders and setting clear priorities in a complex environment.
- Additional European language skills are a plus

What You Gain

Newell Brands has a strong footprint in the EMEA region, with several thousand employees spread over many corporate offices and manufacturing facilities. You might recognise some of our iconic brands, like Parker, Sistema, Spontex, Crockpot, NUK, Coleman, and Yankee Candle, to name a few.

Join us and benefit from:

- Flexible hybrid working system (on average 3 days in the office and 2 days at home p.w.)
- Unlimited access to LinkedIn Learning – 17,000+ courses for your professional and personal development
- Bravo – our global recognition programme where teammates can recognise each other and exceptional work is rewarded
